messages.subject: plot_pxg
parts:
Hi,

I am using the Arabidopsis MAGIC population and I am struggling to figure out how to swap the 'AA, BB, CC...' genotype labels on my x axis for the actual founder genotypes 'Bur, Can, Col...' when using the plot_pxg function. I have a vector with all the founder accessions in correct order, which I used for my plot_coef function, I was wondering if I could use the same vector for the plot_pxg function or is there another way?

Kind regards, 

Klara

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] plot_pxg
parts:
The labels are taken from the input genotypes.
If you are using

  plot_pxg(geno, phenotype, sort=FALSE)

then the labels are taken from the contents of geno. If it's a factor, the labels will be the factor levels. If it's a vector of character strings, it'll be the unique values.

So you need to turn your AA/BB/CC values into strain names.

  str <- c("Bur", "Can", "Col", ...)
 
  # replace factor levels
  levels(geno) <- str

  # or if it's not a factor...
  n_str <- length(str)
  ordered_values <- paste0(LETTERS[1:n_str], LETTERS[1:n_str])
  geno <- str[ match(geno, ordered_values) ]
 
Note that the names of the founders may be as row names in the founder genotypes:

  str <- rownames(arab$founder_geno[[1]])

In the development version of R/qtl2, there's a function founders() that can pull these out:

  str <- founders(arab)

karl

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] plot_pxg
parts:
Thank you for the swift reply. It almost worked, but now I get the following error message when I try to run the plot_pxg(): 

Error in plot_pxg(c42, cross$pheno[, "C4"], sort = FALSE, ylab = "Percentage of seed aborted",  :
  length(geno) != length(pheno)

My pheno file doesn't contain all of the 703 genotyped MLs, but it hasn't caused any problem until now. I have attached a photo of what my output of maxmarg() looked like before and after I ran the code you sent me. I am very new to R and R/qtl2, but it seems to me that because the MAGIC IDs disappeared R doesn't know how to pair geno with pheno unless the lengths are equal? If there isn't an easy fix I am happy to do some cheeky plot image editing. It's not that important. 

Kind regards,

Klara
